What it brings together

Spring resistance

A guided sliding grip moves against a pair of springs for repeated finger curls and light, timed exercise.

Made for either hand

A shaped palm support and rounded thumb recesses on both sides provide a place to press against.

Flexible mounting

Integrated slots accept two 25 mm straps, so the device can be secured to a thigh or a round support.

Guided sessions

The companion iPhone app supports alternating sets, rest timers, timed endurance sessions and a local training log.

Optional force sensing and Bluetooth feedback are part of the design; hardware commissioning and calibration are still pending.

Before applying loadFit all four M3 rear-support screws before adding spring preload. The locating pegs are for spring-free positioning only.

Simplified CAD visualization. Fit, comfort and strength still require physical testing.
